title: Thumbelina
description: A tiny girl born inside a flower is swept far from home and must find her own way through rivers, forests, winter tunnels and finally a warm land of flowers.
catalogueBlurb: A tiny girl crosses a huge world to find a place where she belongs.
author: Hans Christian Andersen, retold by Quill
